issue.title: Add TRACE, CONNECT, and PATCH http methods

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
This is related to #31017. That issue identified that these three http
methods were treated like GET requests. This commit adds them to
RestRequest. This means that these methods will be handled properly and
generate 405s.

body: This has been merged into master. It still needs to be back ported to 6.x.
